title: Companies with 100+ Employees Must Update Data by August 31
seoTitle: Companies to Update Data by August 31
subtitle: Submitted information will be used for the 6th Salary Transparency Report.
excerpt: Private companies with 100 or more employees have until August 31 to update their data for the 6th Salary Transparency Report.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Private companies with 100 or more employees must update their information by August 31.

Purpose of the Data

The submission and validation of information provided by companies will serve as a direct basis for the preparation of the 6th Salary Transparency and Remuneration Criteria Report.

The document is structured and released periodically, being prepared and published semiannually based on records submitted by organizations meeting the employee count criterion.

With information from Agência Brasil.
